purpose: Validate sustained-load instrumentation and bounded-concurrency profiles, not rank stacks or measure maximum capacity.
notes: Profiles and sequence fixed in the batch command before the first result; serialized here during collection.
Run sequentially with benchmark builds/tests paused. This is a shared host, not proven contention-free.
Each receipt resolves stack and infrastructure tags to immutable image IDs.
The sink enforces a nominal 50ms processing delay, with additional measured service overhead.
No latency SLO or infrastructure headroom qualification; completion does not imply sustainable offered rate.
